title: supabase.com/pricing.md
snippet:
Supabase offers four plans: Free, Pro, Team, and Enterprise. All plans include unlimited API requests. Projects on paid plans aren't paused for inactivity.

## Plan Tiers
### Free - from $0/month
- Unlimited API requests
- 50,000 monthly active users
- 500 MB database size (Shared CPU • 500 MB RAM)
- 5 GB egress
- 5 GB cached egress
- 1 GB file storage
- Community support
- Note: Free projects are paused after 1 week of inactivity. Limit of 2 active projects.
### Pro - from $25/month
- 100,000 monthly active users (then $0.00325 per MAU)
- 8 GB disk size per project (then $0.125 per GB)
- 250 GB egress (then $0.09 per GB)
- 250 GB cached egress (then $0.03 per GB)
- 100 GB file storage (then $0.0213 per GB)
- Email support
- Daily backups stored for 7 days
- 7-day log retention
- Add Log Drains (additional $60 per drain, per project)
### Team - from $599/month
- SOC2 & ISO 27001
- Project-scoped and read-only access
- HIPAA available as paid add-on
- SSO for Supabase Dashboard
- Priority email support & SLAs
- Daily backups stored for 14 days
- 28-day log retention
### Enterprise - custom pricing
- Technical Account Management
- Uptime SLAs
- Supports AWS PrivateLink
- 24×7×365 premium enterprise support
- Private Slack channel
- Custom Security Questionnaires

title: Supabase Pricing 2026: Free Tier Limits & Costs
snippet:
Supabase pricing starts at $0. The Free plan gives you 2 active projects, each with a 500 MB database, plus 50,000 monthly active users, 1 GB of file storage and 5 GB of egress. Pro costs $25 a month and includes $10 of compute credit, enough for one small project. Team starts at $599 a month, and Enterprise is custom.

- Past 100,000 monthly active users, auth becomes the biggest line on the bill: every extra 10,000 users costs $32.50.
- All plans include unlimited API requests, so you pay for resources and users, not for queries.

| Plan | Price | Built for | What you get |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Free** | $0 | Prototypes, learning, side projects | 2 active projects, shared CPU with 500 MB RAM, 500 MB database per project, community support |
| **Pro** | From $25/month | Launched apps | $10 compute credit, 8 GB disk per project, 100,000 MAU, daily backups kept 7 days, email support, no pausing |
| **Team** | From $599/month | Companies with compliance needs | Pro features plus SOC 2 and ISO 27001, SSO for the dashboard, read-only roles, 14-day backups, 28-day logs |
| **Enterprise** | Custom | Large workloads | Uptime SLAs, 24/7 support, a technical account manager, private Slack channel |

| Resource | Free plan limit |
|---|---|
| Active projects | 2 (paused projects don't count) |
| Database size | 500 MB per project |
| Compute | Shared CPU, 500 MB RAM |
| Monthly active users | 50,000 |
| File storage | 1 GB |
| Max file upload | 50 MB |
| Egress | 5 GB, plus 5 GB of cached egress |
| Edge Function invocations | 500,000 per month |
| Realtime messages | 2 million per month |
| Realtime peak connections | 200 |
| API requests | Unlimited |
| Automatic backups | None |
| Log retention | 1 day |
| Image transformations | Not included |
| Custom domains | Not included |
| Support | Community |
| Pausing | After 1 week of inactivity |

Yes, Supabase is free to start, and the pricing page puts no time limit on the Free plan. It isn't unlimited, though, and it isn't built for production.
When a Free organization keeps going over its quota, Supabase applies its Fair Use Policy. You get a notice and a grace period first. After that, the [billing FAQ](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/platform/billing-faq) lists the restrictions: pausing projects, switching databases to read-only, blocking new projects, or answering every API request with a 402 error. They lift when the quota resets next cycle or when you upgrade.
